outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution heatmaps overlaid on tissue H&E images (a spot-based heatmap type of plot), not a bar chart of means, so individual data point overlay is not applicable/needed.

Panel B is a box plot showing the distribution (median, quartiles, min/max) of the cell fraction data; box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points, and individual points are in fact also displayed here.
Panel C consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points on line plots is not meaningful/readable.

Panel D is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values derived from differential gene expression analysis of spatial transcriptomics data (a single computed statistic per gene from the DEG test), not an average across biological replicates, so there are no underlying individual replicate data points to overlay.
Panel E shows representative H&E and IHC micrographs/photographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
